required_transition_law: reserve(effect, authorization, presented_execution_fence) -> atomically validate presented fence == current canonical execution and persist immutable binding
begin_attempt(effect, presented_execution_fence) -> compare presented fence == immutable reservation fence == current canonical execution
retry(effect, presented_execution_fence) -> same triple comparison; stale uncertain work becomes reconciliation, not retry
provider_precommit(effect_attempt, presented_execution_fence) -> final current-fence recheck immediately before external emission
outcome observation/reconciliation may continue after turnover as evidence; it may not authorize a new provider attempt
stale/rejected execution cannot write authoritative effect/state just because rejection occurred; trusted current telemetry plane may record security evidence separately
recovery_law: process death may release physical flock but does not itself validate semantic recovery
expired/crashed active epoch -> RECOVERING, not direct successor acquisition
validated recovery proves no current valid holder/effect execution remains and records recovery provenance
only after recovery validation may epoch advance/clear to IDLE and a new execution acquire
precrash reservations remain fenced to old execution; successor needs fresh authorization/reservation unless an explicitly safe evidence-only reconciliation rule applies
architecture_delta.same_holder_law: same session/client/holder identity is not automatically same execution. Reentry may reuse an execution only for the same logical admitted request/continuation identity; a distinct request cannot become a second active cognition merely because holder tuple matches.
